description: The file defines a Java Servlet class named DeleteManager responsible for handling HTTP POST requests to delete a manager (employee) based on their ID, interacting with the database utility class.

classes.name: DeleteManager
classes.description: A servlet that processes delete requests for managers, deleting the manager by ID and redirecting based on success.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to delete a manager based on provided employee ID; redirects on success or forwards to error page on failure.
